purpose: Every registry and owner file: who owns it, which code reads it, which test guards it. Agents read this first.
User stories: what the owner wants, why, and when it counts as done.
Same ids: status, blocking issue, notes, proposed rewording.
One name and one definition per business idea, in the client's words.
Where each term lives in data and code; proposed new terms.
Threshold defaults: the only place a number lives.
Business rules: when X, do Y; thresholds named, never numbered; the stories each rule serves.
Same ids: the implementing function, notes, proposed rewording.
Every message a --json document can carry: wording per language and its params, checked both ways.
Every business fact a human can set: unit, bounds, required or not.
Every per-entity decision: its value domain and whether a human must confirm it.
Alert rules as rows: grain, metric, comparison, threshold, cooldown.
One read-only check per done story: the verb, what its JSON must hold, the tables it needs.
